div.p: As Odoo databases scale, physical attachments (PDFs, images, CAD files) consume up to 90% of your expensive server storage. This degrades database backup speeds, inflates hosting costs, and slows down system migrations. The Document Engine intercepts Odoo attachments, securely routes them to Dropbox via OAuth 2.0 REST APIs, and replaces the heavy binaries with lightweight, clickable 0kb pointers.

div.p: An enterprise-grade, non-blocking audit terminal giving your system administrators complete, read-only diagnostic visibility over every file transfer, API call, error, and sync trigger — in real time.

div.p: Synchronization happens in background CRON jobs, completely invisible to the user. The Activity Logs Terminal is the diagnostic window into this background engine. It captures every single operation — successes, failures, duration, trigger source, and the exact Dropbox path — giving administrators the power to debug, audit, and optimize the sync pipeline without touching production data.

div.p: The logging engine is wrapped in a strict try/except failsafe block. If the database encounters an error while writing a log record, the exception is caught and silently discarded. This guarantees that actual Dropbox syncs never crash due to a logging failure. The sync always takes priority over its own audit trail.

div.style: background: #f8f9fa; border-left: 4px solid #34a853; border-radius: 6px; padding: 20px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px;

div.p: The engine reads the Odoo execution context to identify exactly what caused the sync operation. It differentiates between 4 trigger types: Manual (user button click), Auto (chatter upload), Cron (background job), and Historical Setup (initial migration).

div.style: background: #f8f9fa; border-left: 4px solid #ea4335; border-radius: 6px; padding: 20px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px;

div.p: Background CRON jobs elevate to a system-level "sudo" user for permissions. Before escalation, the engine captures the original human user's ID. This means every log entry correctly names the Odoo user who triggered the operation — even for automated tasks — ensuring full accountability in the audit trail.

A strict SQL unique constraint ensures only one configuration per model is ever active, preventing conflicting sync rules.

div.p: A robust filtering mechanism ensures the same file is never uploaded twice. If a direct and a chatter attachment for the same file exist, only one copy is synced to Dropbox.

div.style: background: #f8f9fa; border-left: 4px solid #ea4335; border-radius: 6px; padding: 18px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px;

div.p: Zero-byte URL pointers from "Dropbox Only" mode are strictly excluded from re-upload cycles — preventing empty ghost files from polluting Dropbox on subsequent syncs.

div.style: background: #f8f9fa; border-left: 4px solid #7C4DFF; border-radius: 6px; padding: 18px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px;

div.p: A SQL UNIQUE constraint prevents duplicate configs. Attempting to create two active configurations for sale.order raises a validation error immediately.

div.style: background: #202124; border-radius: 12px; padding: 28px 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px;

div.p: Beyond the 8 pre-configured models, you can add any custom Odoo model. Navigate to Dropbox > Attachments Config, create a new record, select your model, choose a Storage Mode, and assign a Root Folder. The engine handles the rest automatically.
